findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/validation-evidence-artifact-growth.md:7 — all six CHK-001 docs_check receipts can pass for the wrong reason, so none is valid must-intent coverage. Read-only stream mutations proved: happy:0 still PASSes after deleting lines 7-15 (the decision section); happy:1 still PASSes after deleting line 27 onward (shipped mechanism, measurements, transcripts, and retained finding table); edge:0 still PASSes after deleting semantic-consistency and evidence-truth clauses; edge:1 still PASSes after replacing all concrete triggers with only `Reconsider only if.`; adversarial:0 and adversarial:1 still PASS after prepending paraphrased active mandates (`Follow-up owner: TBD. Implement this proposal in a new story.` / `This proposal must now be implemented in a new story.`). WHY high: every intent is must coverage, but the positive regexes use alternation where conjunction/preservation checks are required and the negative scans enumerate only exact historical phrases instead of testing the claimed whole-document semantic property. The current document reads correctly, but these receipts would not detect regression; replace them with checks that independently require each positive claim, compare preserved historical sections/content, and reject broader active-mandate wording or provide a truthful manual whole-document transcript.
findings.resolvedReason: Replanned all six must-intent verifiers at metadata commits 2ca1ce2 and cc53243 so required claims are conjunctive, concrete reopen triggers are individually required, historical measurements/transcripts/finding IDs are pinned, and affirmative active mandates are rejected while must not is allowed. findings.desc: concept-cleanup: packages/main/src/tasks/validation-evidence-buffer-smoke.ts:227 and :710-717 still encode the retired active follow-up posture after docs/requirements/decisions/validation-evidence-artifact-growth.md:9,15 explicitly declines it.
